article.heading: Plan your first project with GitHub Copilot
article.description: Use GitHub Copilot to move from a rough idea to a clear, reviewable project plan that your team can build from.
article.body:
GitHub Copilot can help teams turn early ideas into structured plans. Start by describing the outcome, the people involved, and the decisions that are still open.

Before you start

Gather the context your team already has. Useful inputs include existing issues, product notes, customer feedback, and examples of similar work.

  • Define the goal in one or two sentences.
  • List constraints, dependencies, and known risks.
  • Capture the first milestone your team should validate.

Create the first draft

Ask Copilot for a concise plan that separates scope, implementation steps, and review criteria. Keep the first draft short so reviewers can respond quickly.

Review and refine

Share the draft with your team, resolve open questions, and turn the agreed next steps into issues or tasks. Revisit the plan as new information appears.
